front_attempt_1.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: independent female FRONT HAIR layer for a modular Chinese xianxia portrait game.
Edit target Image 1 is original front-hair PNG. Image 2 is the original assembled portrait for scale and traditional drawing language only. Image 3 is fixed bald head geometry for fit only. Output ONLY the revised front hair on genuinely transparent RGBA background, exact 1024x1536 canvas, retain shared canvas origin; do NOT output a character, skin, ears, face, eyes, eyebrows, clothing, guide marks, text, background or checkerboard.
Refine the original center-parted long hair, strictly straight-on front view. Preserve the overall long hairstyle and two complete naturally tapering chest-front locks to about y1015, but make their mass and flow coherent and calm; no thin string pair, no large loops or flyaway curls. The front hair includes the complete frontal crown, central part, hairline, temples and chest-front locks. It is NOT the long back curtain. Natural cap gently follows actual head bone; less tall puffy helmet and less lateral bulge than input. Head axis x519; visible crown highest point near (519,145); central parted hairline lower inner edge (519,277); temple hairline joins (442,310),(596,310). Bare face opening below center hairline remains fully transparent, broad enough that central eyebrows and eyes in x430..610,y345..400 are unobscured; curved temples may frame outside that area. Preserve natural forehead proportions and two temples, no low bangs or hair mask.
Style: our own traditional Chinese gongbi fine lines with softly brushed ink shading, subtle dry paper grain INSIDE hair only. Matte deep charcoal-black body approximately #171615 to #242321, low-contrast warm-dark-gray highlights limited to restrained individual strand groups. The hair must read BLACK, not gray-brown, silver, shiny, glossy 3D wig, dense pale stripes, metallic white streaks or rim-lit. Keep alpha-native smooth tapered edges with no opaque halo. Simplify scattered wiry flyaways into a few integrated flowing strands. Refine existing hairstyle, not a new bun or accessory design. No ornament or ribbon. Exact canvas and shared positions are critical.
